newsitem.title: USA: Integra LifeSciences in Japanese alliance.
newsitem.headline: Integra LifeSciences in Japanese alliance.

text.p: Integra LifeSciences Corp said Thursday it has signed an exclusive importation and sales agreement for Integra Artificial Skin in Japan with Century Medical Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of Itochu Corp.

"This is a major step forward in securing the import license and regulatory approvals needed for Integra Artificial Skin from the Japanese government. We look forward to a successful association," Senior Vice President of Marketing and Sales Andre Decarie said in a statement.
Decarie said that approvals for usage in Japan would combine both the burn as well as the plastic and reconstructive surgery markets, which is estimated at more than $100 million annually.

Century is to oversee and manage the company's clinical trials required for approval by the Japanese government, the company said. It said it plans to implement the regulatory approval process within a month.
Upon completion of the approval process, Century will serve as Integra's exclusive distributor and importer in Japan for regenerative products, the company said.
